summary: A bottom sheet that springs up over its page, follows your finger when dragged down and either dismisses or springs back depending on distance and speed.
use: Mobile pickers, filters, share menus and any secondary task that should feel attached to the screen instead of popping in.
spec: `MotionStage` with `label="Sheet spring: a bottom sheet springs up and drags down to dismiss"` and `loop={2600}`
`new Spring(SHEET, { stiffness: 0.2, damping: 0.75 })` with `const SHEET = 256`: offset 0 is open, `SHEET` is hidden
The sheet reads `transform: translateY(var(--y))`; the scrim opacity follows `calc(var(--o) * 0.5)`
Drag down follows the pointer 1:1 with `{ instant: true }`; dragging up divides by `4` (rubber band)
Release dismisses past `SHEET * 0.3` or faster than `0.5` px/ms, otherwise the spring returns to 0; Escape also closes it
Under reduced motion the sheet is open and moves with `{ instant: true }`
names: Sheet com mola e arrastar para fechar
Hoja con resorte y arrastrar para cerrar
